verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਸਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g bhagat vachhal hoi vas gat aaiaa|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is holy congregation and controlled by this holy congregation, the Lord comes here as lover of the devotees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaaran karate vas hai saadhasa(n)gat vich kare karaiaa|

en.bdb: All the causes are under control of the creator but in the holy congregation He does everything in accordance with the wishes of the devotees and the saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham saadhasa(n)gat vich bhaanaa bhaiaa|

en.bdb: The transcendetal Brahm is the perfect Brahm and He likes the will of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR samaiaa|

en.bdb: In his every trichome are absorbed crores of universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੀਅਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ਵੜੁ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬੀਉ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: beeahu kar bisathaar vaR fal a(n)dhar fir beeau vasaiaa|

en.bdb: From one seed comes out banyan tree and in its fruits again the seeds reside.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: apiau peean ajar jaran aap gavai na aap janaiaa|

en.bdb: Who quaffing the nectar have devotedly adopted the unbearable in their mind, the eschewing their ego have never made themselves noticed.
Such true persons while being amidst maya have attained that immaculate Lord.
